strategies.name: Delta-Neutral Cash & Carry Arbitrage
strategies.edge: Exploits positive funding rate differentials on USDⓈ-M Perps without taking directional price risk.
execution: 1. Query futures_usds.premiumIndexKlineData to find high positive funding pairs (> 0.03% per 8h, > 32% annualized).
3. Simultaneously open 1x Short USDⓈ-M Perpetual via futures_usds.newOrder.
4. Net delta = 0 (immune to market dumps or pumps). Collects funding payments every 8 hours directly into sub-account.

strategies.name: Mean-Reversion Bollinger Breakout DCA
strategies.edge: Captures sharp liquidity wicks and oversold flash crashes on high-volume pairs.
execution: 1. Calculate 20-period SMA and +/- 2 standard deviation Bollinger Bands on 1h klines via spot.klines.
2. When price pierces Lower Band and RSI-14 < 28: trigger entry tranche 1.
3. Place limit take-profit ladder at the 20-period SMA middle band.
4. Enforce trailing stop-loss at 2.5% below entry.

strategies.name: Cross-DEX / CeFi Basis Spread Arbitrage
strategies.edge: Monitors basis premium between Spot and Quarterly Delivery contracts.
execution: 1. Compare spot.tickerPrice with futures_usds quarterly contract (e.g. BTCUSDT vs BTCUSDT_260925).
2. When basis spread expands > 4% annualized above risk-free rate: Long spot, Short quarterly contract.
3. Locks in fixed convergence profit on settlement date with zero liquidation risk.

strategies.name: Liquidity Absorption Orderbook Imbalance Hunter
strategies.edge: Front-runs institutional accumulation walls before price breakouts.
execution: 1. Fetch spot.depth (limit: 50) and compute bid-to-ask depth imbalance ratio.
2. If bid depth / ask depth > 2.2 within 1% of mid-market: institutional absorption detected.
3. Cross-reference with analysis.getTokenAiReport for sentiment verification.
4. Enter early with tight stop placed immediately behind the bid liquidity wall.
